TITAN.status: Public historical SFH summary catalogue remains available and used by population_transport; no final6983 membership or joint per-host SFH/dust posterior release identified in these inspected repositories. Other galaxy_photometry files include unrelated JWST/CEERS work and do not establish release of TITAN likelihoods.

Ramaiya2025.data_statement: Optical/infrared data public; DES-SN5YR linked. No assembled501-host photometry, gold mask or joint posterior download linked in paper.

Ramaiya2025.source_equivalence: Pinned HELP source map index identifies CDFS-SWIRE-NEST and XMM-LSS-NEST SMAPv6.0 files; generation code copies IMAGE values without calibration rescaling.
